description: onion/3 Sphinx-style header-blinded multi-hop relay cells (section 15.9). Ephemeral scalars, payload fill and tail padding are derived from fixed labels for reproducibility.

rejected.name: cellTooSmall
rejected.description: Cell smaller than 512 bytes must be rejected.

rejected.name: cellTooLarge
rejected.description: Cell larger than 2048 bytes must be rejected.

rejected.name: allZeroAlpha
rejected.description: Low-order/all-zero alpha produces all-zero X25519 shared secret and must be rejected.

rejected.name: tamperedAlpha
rejected.description: Tampering with alpha changes the derived keys and fails MAC verification.

rejected.name: tamperedBeta
rejected.description: Tampering with beta fails gamma MAC verification.

rejected.name: tamperedGamma
rejected.description: Tampering with gamma fails MAC verification.

rejected.name: tamperedDelta
rejected.description: Tampering with delta fails gamma MAC verification because gamma authenticates alpha || beta || delta.

rejected.name: replayedCell
rejected.description: A cell whose replayKey is already in the relay replay cache must be rejected with E_REPLAY.

rejected.name: invalidHopType
rejected.description: A cell with valid MAC whose decrypted hopType is neither 0x01 nor 0x02 must be dropped with E_ONION_INVALID.

rejected.name: payloadLengthExceedsCapacity
rejected.description: An exit cell whose payload length exceeds delta.length - 2 must be dropped with E_ONION_INVALID.
